page.overview:
Who is Fado?

When is a child, he can find standing atop a lookout post, accessed by bridges leading from the roof of . Here, she teaches how to look around in the first-person view, and warns him about the ' dangers.

If returns to as an adult, will no longer be found in her home village, instead being encountered in the during the Trading Quest to obtain . When brings the for the , appears instead, demanding that give the medicine to her since it was made of forest . In return, she gives the that the left behind. She wonders aloud about the young man's fate, mentioning that any non- that enter the wind up turning into . Following this interaction, is never seen again.
